title: Introduction to Educational Psychology: Main Exam, 23 April 2021
department: Department of Educational Psychology and Technology
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Account for individual differences in learning.
Outline the role of motivation in the learning process.
Expound the role of environment in personality development.
Outline the characteristics of a well-adjusted student in school.
Explain the purpose of punishment in education.
Demonstrate how you can meet the individual needs of learners.
Explain how you can avoid negative transfer of learning in your class.
Discuss the importance of educational psychology to a teacher trainee.
Elaborate on how learners react to problems in school.
Discuss the negative effects of punishment in school.
Outline the importance of school emotional climate on learners' academic achievement.
Discuss the contribution of classical conditioning to modern teaching and learning.
